name: Physically Based API
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: CC0 JSON of measured material values: linear sRGB base colour, IOR, metalness, density
summary: api.physicallybased.info/v2/materials returns 122 materials with base colours in srgb-linear and acescg, IOR or complex IOR, metalness, transmission, density and per-value references. Pin a copy: the live data changes. The fixture reads a 9-material subset offline.
use_when: A scene needs a citable albedo, IOR or metalness for a named material instead of a guessed one
A look-developer review needs a number to compare a surface against
avoid_when: Textures or full material graphs: this is scalar and colour values only
Stylised looks where physical values are not the aim
notes: 2026-11-27: Lead said schema 2.2 and CC0; confirmed: response header license is CC0 1.0 Universal, schemaVersion 2.2, updated 2026-11-03. The full response is 341,944 bytes, over the 200 KB pin limit, so the example pins a verbatim 9-material subset (25 KB). The README images use a CC BY 4.0 shader ball, which is not pinned.

2026-11-27: Data, not software: the catalogue has no dataset class and ADR 0011 (inspiration library) does not cover reference data. Carded as a remote-api resource; a reviewer may prefer a references/ home. No capability in the vocabulary fits; proposed addition: reference-data.
2026-11-27: srgb-linear values may exceed 1 (Gold red is 1.059); clamp or convert before display.

assessment.rationale: CC0 stated in both the API header and the repository README; anonymous GET, no key. Fills the gap that materials and lighting skills have no citable reference values. Source quality varies per value; references are listed per material.

evidence.result: 9 pinned materials parse; Water IOR 1.3325, Ice 1.3098, Diamond 2.4168; Gold linear sRGB [1.059, 0.773, 0.307] (R/B 3.45), Copper red-orange, Silver and Aluminum near-neutral; metalness 0 for dielectrics, 1 for metals; two runs identical.
evidence.scope: Offline read of a pinned 9-material subset against predeclared constants; not the live endpoint after 2026-11-27, other materials, or rendered appearance.
